1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora, de hasta 9 m de altura, con bejucos largos, fibrosos y resistentes, hojas lobuladas, flores solitarias de gran tamaño, aromáticas, de color amarillento con tonos púrpuras. Passifloraceae; Passiflora incarnata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant, reaching up to 9 m in height, with long, fibrous and resistant vines, lobed leaves, solitary flowers of large size, aromatic, yellowish in color with purple undertones. Passifloraceae; Passiflora incarnata.
